name: One Stop Centre (Sakhi)
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
target_group: Women affected by violence or in need of integrated support
eligibility: Women requiring assistance can access services through One Stop Centres according to programme guidelines.
benefits: Integrated support including medical, legal, psychological and counselling assistance and temporary shelter/referral support.
documents: Documents relevant to the case, if required
application_process: Contact/visit the nearest One Stop Centre or designated district women and child development authority.
source: Ministry of Women and Child Development / Government of India
